system.description:
You place your target under a powerful illusion that projects a torrent of crows or an animal of your choice that strike, swarm and terrorize your target for the duration. The affected creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Success: Affected creature is Off-Guard until the end of their next turn, then this jutsu ends.

Failure: Affected creature is Off-Guard for the duration. Affected creature can end this jutsu by spending its Reaction on its turn to shake this effect from themselves.

Critical Failure: Same as failure but they also gain 1 rank of Weaken for the duration.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the number of creatures you can target by +1.
